sponsor.text: Conteúdo apoiado por TechEnglish — Cursos focados em tecnologia e negócios.

A1.fullText: Many people drink coffee every morning. Coffee gives them good energy for the day. Some like it with milk and sugar.
sentences: Many people drink coffee every morning.
Coffee gives them good energy for the day.
Some like it with milk and sugar.

A2.fullText: Coffee is one of the most popular beverages in the world. People usually buy a cup on their way to work or meet friends at a local café.
sentences: Coffee is one of the most popular beverages in the world.
People usually buy a cup on their way to work.
They also meet friends at a local café.

B1.fullText: Coffee culture has grown significantly over recent decades. While instant coffee was once the standard, many consumers now prefer freshly ground beans and specialized brewing methods.
sentences: Coffee culture has grown significantly over recent decades.
While instant coffee was once the standard, many consumers now prefer freshly ground beans.
Specialized brewing methods are becoming widely appreciated.

B2.fullText: The global coffee industry blends agricultural science with cultural ritual. Specialty cafés emphasize the bean's origin, roast profiles, and fair-trade sourcing practices.
sentences: The global coffee industry blends agricultural science with cultural ritual.
Specialty cafés emphasize the bean's origin and roast profiles.
Fair-trade sourcing practices are increasingly prioritized by consumers.

C1.fullText: Coffee houses historically served as intellectual hubs, fostering political discourse and Enlightenment philosophies. Today, they remain communal spaces, albeit transformed by the ubiquity of laptops and remote work.
sentences: Coffee houses historically served as intellectual hubs, fostering political discourse.
They provided spaces where Enlightenment philosophies could flourish.
Today, they remain communal spaces, albeit transformed by remote work.

C2.fullText: The contemporary commodity trade in coffee is intrinsically entwined with geopolitical nuance and ecological precarity. From single-origin micro-lots to industrial extraction, its supply chain exemplifies the complexities of modern consumption.
sentences: The contemporary commodity trade in coffee is intrinsically entwined with geopolitical nuance.
Ecological precarity poses a growing threat to traditional cultivation zones.
Its supply chain exemplifies the ethical complexities of modern global consumption.
